g.text: PROJECT VALKYRIE // ASV-09 DEEP-SPACE MULTI-ROLE CREW & CARGO TRANSPORT
MASTER GENERAL ARRANGEMENT & STRUCTURAL INBOARD PROFILE — 5-VIEW ORTHOGRAPHIC & SECTIONAL SCHEMATIC (SCALE 1:40 // 25 PX = 1.0 M)
PORT (-Y): PAYLOAD BAY OPEN / STARBOARD (+Y): OML & TPS
PORT CLAMSHELL DOOR OPEN // PAYLOAD CRADLE
CREW MODULE DORSAL CUPOLA & STAR TRACKERS
LANDING CONFIGURATION // GEAR, HGA & RADIATORS DEPLOYED
LONGITUDINAL CENTERLINE SECTION — INTERNAL TANKS, HABITAT, ECLSS, AVIONICS & PROPULSION
DUAL ZERO-G COUCHES // OPTICAL HUD & MFDs
AMINE CO2 SCRUBBER, O2/N2 TANKS & CLOSED-LOOP WATER RECOVERY
MAIN LOX OXIDIZER TANK & SUMP TUNNEL
INSULATED DOWNCOMER FEEDLINE TO AFT MANIFOLD
LOOKING AFT FROM STA 0.0 // SCALE 1:40 (25 PX = 1.0 M)
LOOKING FWD FROM STA 36.0 // PROPULSION & RADIATOR GEOMETRY
01. RADOME & RCS: STA 0.0–2.4 (Ku-Band Lidar, 4× RCS Quads)
02. COCKPIT: STA 2.4–6.4 (2-Pilot Flight Deck, Silica Windows)
03. AVIONICS & HGA: STA 6.4–7.8 (3× Flight Computers, Ka Dish)
04. AIRLOCK & DOCKING: STA 7.8–10.0 (Port EVA Hatch, Dorsal IDSS)
05. CREW & ECLSS: STA 10.0–16.4 (Bunks, Galley, Sub-Floor Scrubbers)
06. CARGO & SOLAR: STA 16.4–24.4 (Clamshell Bay, RMS Arm, Solar Wings)
07. TANKS & RADIATORS: STA 24.4–32.4 (LCH4/LOX Tanks, COPVs, ATCS)
08. PROPULSION & GEAR: STA 32.4–36.0 (2× RME-420, 4× OMS, Outriggers)
APPLIES UNIFORMLY TO TOP, SIDE, FRONT, REAR & CUTAWAY VIEWS
LEAD ARCHITECT: DR. K. VANCE, PE
DESIGN AUTHORITY // ADVANCED ORBITAL SYSTEMS DIVISION
TOP • SIDE • FRONT • REAR • SECTION A-A LONGITUDINAL CUTAWAY
